اعتقلتن (form VIII)
# اِعْتَقَلْتُنَّ (iʕtaqaltunna) /iʕ.ta.qal.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِعْتَقَلَ (iʕtaqala)
# اُعْتُقِلْتُنَّ (uʕtuqiltunna) /uʕ.tu.qil.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِعْتَقَلَ (iʕtaqala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
